# Tables of contents and structural schemas of the 33 hadith compilations

Prepared 2026-10-11. Corpus release: `2026-10-07-18caf2f`. Collections ordered by compiler death year (AH), matching the chronological catalogue.

## Scope and certainty

This exports source heading nodes, not a generic table assembled from memory. Arabic headings, order and nesting are preserved from the saved Iftaʾ Sunnah/HadithWeb source. Every raw HTML snapshot used is checked against its recorded SHA-256 and byte length. Original trees are reparsed and compared with their saved snapshots; additional nested levels are recovered from primary-source pages. Narration leaves are excluded from the table of contents. Source node IDs identify headings, not hadith numbers.

**Certainty has limits:** this describes the source edition represented by the corpus, not every printed edition or the original compiler’s universal schema. Recovery follows unaccounted IDs in the source’s shared heading/report sequence within the corpus’s ID span; the audit below records any remaining gaps. This is not a claim about lost volumes or material outside that span. Source spellings and apparent mistakes are reproduced, not silently corrected. Mixed or narrator-based divisions are not relabelled as invented kitābs or bābs.

**English is not uniformly verified.** D = existing HadithCritic heading-dictionary rendering (not independently re-certified here); C = corpus English attached to the exact matching Arabic heading, unverified and sometimes machine-translated; N = identifying English gloss using a uniquely matching narrator-register alias, not a complete word-for-word translation of the heading or its honorifics; M = no verified English equivalent available. C may contain mistranslations. Multiple C variants are shown rather than selecting a false certainty. No parent receives the English of a different first-child heading. Arabic is authoritative for this export.

A known example: the corpus renders **وقوت الصلاة** as “The **virtue of prayer**”. That is not an accurate translation of “prayer times”. This illustrates why C entries must not be treated as certain translations.

The detailed tables below deliberately retain the existing English data with explicit provenance. A fully certified bilingual edition would require separate review of every C and M heading; this export does not claim that review occurred.

Primary source: [Iftaʾ Sunnah compilation catalogue](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/Book/IndexMatnBooks). Snapshot manifests: `data/ifta-toc/manifest.json` and `data/ifta-toc/deep-manifest.json`; original source trees: `data/ifta-toc/<platform ID>.json`; English dictionary: `data/kitab-titles-en.json`; exact-heading English: read-only `dist-db/silsilah.db`.

<a id="muwatta-malik"></a>

## Muwatta' Malik / موطأ مالك

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → topical chapter/heading → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented Muwattaʾ. Lower headings do not all carry an explicit bāb prefix. The table reproduces this source’s order rather than a different recension’s numbering.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=7&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 7; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 53; L2: 701. **Corpus reports:** 1,781.

## Musnad al-Tayalisi / مسند الطيالسي

**Schema:** Companion/transmission heading → subsidiary transmission heading (where present) → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">صحابي أو مجموعة ← عنوان فرعي عند وجوده ← الروايات</span>

Narrator-based musnad. Preserve the source’s second-level headings: the website’s flat presentation omits this level.

## Musnad al-Humaydi / مسند الحميدي

**Schema:** Companion heading → subsidiary heading (where present) → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">صحابي أو مجموعة ← عنوان فرعي عند وجوده ← الروايات</span>

<a id="musannaf-ibn-abi-shaybah"></a>

## Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah / مصنف ابن أبي شيبة

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → thematic heading → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented muṣannaf. Many lower headings are statements or questions without the word bāb. The 44 root divisions here are this platform’s TOC, distinct from the unpublished 41-boundary alignment pilot described in the repository.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=15&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 15; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 44; L2: 5378; L3: 122. **Corpus reports:** 39,096.

## Musnad Ahmad / مسند أحمد

**Schema:** Companion/group → individual Companion or narration heading → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">صحابي أو مجموعة صحابة ← صحابي أو عنوان رواية ← الروايات</span>

Grouped musnad: named Companions, household/tribal/regional groups, and women. The lower divisions are not uniformly topical bābs.

## Musnad al-Darimi / مسند الدارمي

**Schema:** Introduction/topical kitāb → bāb → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

## Sahih al-Bukhari / صحيح البخاري

**Schema:** Kitāb/thematic division → bāb or sūra heading → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented collection with additional Qurʾānic-commentary organization. Sūra labels are retained as source headings, not relabelled uniformly as bābs.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=1&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 1; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 97; L2: 3641. **Corpus reports:** 7,410.

<a id="sunan-ibn-majah"></a>

## Sunan Ibn Majah / سنن ابن ماجه

**Schema:** Thematic abwāb division → bāb → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

The source’s root headings are principally abwāb (chapter groups), not uniformly titled kitāb.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=6&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 6; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 39; L2: 1513. **Corpus reports:** 4,467.

## Al-Marasil li-Abi Dawud / المراسيل لأبي داود

**Schema:** Single sequence of kitāb and topical headings → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">عناوين كتب وأبواب في مستوى واحد ← الروايات</span>

<a id="musnad-al-bazzar"></a>

## Musnad al-Bazzar / مسند البزار

**Schema:** Companion heading → transmission/narrator heading (where present) → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">صحابي أو مجموعة ← عنوان فرعي عند وجوده ← الروايات</span>

Narrator-based musnad. Many lower headings identify who transmitted from the named Companion rather than a legal topic.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=19&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 19; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 99; L2: 893. **Corpus reports:** 10,417.

## Sunan al-Nasa'i / سنن النسائي

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → bāb/thematic heading → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

<a id="al-sunan-al-kubra"></a>

## Al-Sunan al-Kubra / السنن الكبرى

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → bāb/thematic heading → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Al-Nasāʾī’s al-Sunan al-Kubrā, not al-Bayhaqī’s similarly titled collection and not the separately catalogued Sunan al-Nasāʾī.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=22&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 22; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 64; L2: 2990. **Corpus reports:** 11,981.

## Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah / صحيح ابن خزيمة

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → bāb → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

## Sharh Ma'ani al-Athar / شرح معاني الآثار

**Schema:** Introduction/topical kitāb → bāb of legal discussion → reports/discussion.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented legal discussion, distinct from the flat problem-oriented chapter sequence of Sharḥ Mushkil al-Āthār.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=28&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 28; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 30; L2: 335. **Corpus reports:** 7,051.

## Sharh Mushkil al-Athar / شرح مشكل الآثار

**Schema:** Introduction/problem-oriented bāb → reports/discussion.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو باب في مشكل الآثار ← الروايات والمناقشة</span>

A flat sequence of headings addressing problematic reports; do not impose topical kitāb groups.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=31&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 31; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 1004. **Corpus reports:** 7,274.

## Sahih Ibn Hibban / صحيح ابن حبان

**Schema:** Introduction/topical kitāb → bāb and subsidiary headings → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

This source presents a topical arrangement associated with Ibn Balbān’s rearrangement, confirmed by its [book description](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/Book/Details?bookId=10). The website’s 60 top-level divisions are source navigation divisions, not a claim of 60 original compiler-authored kitābs.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=10&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 10; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 60; L2: 1225. **Corpus reports:** 7,499.

| 4.8 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إثبات نضارة الوجه في القيامة من بلغ للمصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم سنة صحيحة كما سمعها</span> | Chapter: The Establishment of the Radiance of the Face on the Day of Resurrection for He Who Conveys a Sound Year of the Chosen One (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam) as He Heard It | C | 30262 |
| 4.9 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر عدد الأشياء التي استأثر الله تعالى بعلمها دون خلقه</span> | Mention of the number of things that Allah (SWT) knows better than His creation | C | 30264 |
| 4.10 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر خبر ثان يصرح بصحة ما ذكرناه</span> | A second report is mentioned, which confirms the validity of what we mentioned before. | C | 30266 |
| 4.11 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن العلم بأمر الدنيا مع الانهماك فيها والجهل بأمر الآخرة ومجانبة أسبابها</span> | Mention of admonition against acquiring worldly knowledge while immersed in it and neglecting knowledge of the Hereafter and its means | C | 30268 |
| 4.12 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن تتبع المتشابه من القرآن للمرء المسلم</span> | Chapter: Warning Against Following Resemblances in the Qur’an Without Sound Interpretation | C | 30270 |
| 4.13 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر العلة التي من أجلها قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وما جهلتم منه فردوه إلى عالمه</span> | The reason why the Prophet (ﷺ) said, ‘What you do not know of [the Qur’an’s rulings], refer it to its scholar’ | C | 30273 |
| 4.14 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن مجادلة الناس في كتاب الله مع الأمر بمجانبة من يفعل ذلك</span> | Mention of the censure for arguing with people about the Book of Allah while commanding to avoid those who do so | C | 30275 |
| 4.15 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر وصف العلم الذي يتوقع دخول النار في القيامة لمن طلبه</span> | Description of the knowledge (*‘ilm*) for which one expects to enter Hellfire in the Resurrection for seeking it | C | 30277 |
| 4.16 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن مجالسة أهل الكلام والقدر ومفاتحتهم بالنظر والجدال</span> | Mention of the censure for associating with the people of speech, fate, and their disputes, looking and arguing with them | C | 30281 |
| 4.17 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر ما كان يتخوف صلى الله عليه وسلم على أمته جدال المنافق</span> | Mention of what the Prophet ﷺ feared for his ummah regarding the disputes of hypocrites | C | 30283 |
| 4.18 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر ما يجب على المرء أن يسأل الله جل وعلا العلم النافع رزقنا الله إياه وكل مسلم</span> | "The mention of what is incumbent upon a person to ask Allah, the Most High, for beneficial knowledge—may He provide it for us and every Muslim" | C | 30286 |
| 4.19 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر ما يستحب للمرء أن يقرن إلى ما ذكرنا في التعوذ منها أشياء معلومة</span> | Mention of what is recommended for a person to combine with what we have mentioned in seeking refuge from it certain known things | C | 30288 |
| 4.20 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر تسهيل الله جل وعلا طريق الجنة على من يسلك في الدنيا طريقا يطلب فيه علما</span> | Mention of how God, Exalted, makes the path to Paradise easy for one who seeks knowledge in this world | C | 30290 |
| 4.21 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر بسط الملائكة أجنحتها لطلبة العلم رضا بصنيعهم ذلك</span> | Mention of the angels spreading their wings for the seekers of knowledge in approval of their deed | C | 30292 |
| 4.22 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر أمان الله جل وعلا من النار من أوى إلى مجلس علم ونيته فيه صحيحة</span> | Mention of the refuge from the Fire, which is the protection of the one who seeks refuge in the gathering of knowledge and whose intention in it is correct | C | 30294 |
| 4.23 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر التسوية بين طالب العلم ومعلمه وبين المجاهد في سبيل الله</span> | The narration states that the reward is equal for the student of knowledge and his teacher, as well as the warrior in the path of Allah. | C | 30296 |
| 4.24 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر وصف العلماء الذين لهم الفضل الذي ذكرنا قبل</span> | Description of the scholars (*‘ulamā’*) who possess the merit previously mentioned | C | 30298 |
| 4.25 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إرادة الله جل وعلا خير الدارين بمن تفقه في الدين</span> | Mention of Allah's, the Exalted, will to do good to the better of the two houses for those who excel in religion | C | 30300 |
| 4.26 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إباحة الحسد لمن أوتي الحكمة وعلمها الناس</span> | Mention of the permissibility of envying one who has been granted wisdom and teaches it to the people | C | 30302 |
| 4.27 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن من خيار الناس من حسن خلقه في فقهه</span> | Mention of the clarification that among the best of people are those who have good character in their understanding of the religion | C | 30304 |
| 4.28 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن خيار المشركين هم الخيار في الإسلام إذا فقهوا</span> | Mention of the clarification that the best of the polytheists are the best in Islam if they understand | C | 30306 |
| 4.29 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن العلم من خير ما يخلف المرء بعده</span> | Mention of the clarification that knowledge is among the best things a person leaves behind | C | 30308 |
| 4.30 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الأمر بإقالة زلات أهل العلم والدين</span> | Mention of the Command to Overlook the Slips of the People of Knowledge and Religion | C | 30310 |
| 4.31 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إيجاب العقوبة في القيامة على الكاتم العلم الذي يحتاج إليه في أمور المسلمين</span> | Chapter: Mentioning the Guarantee of Punishment on the Day of Resurrection for the Concealer of Knowledge Needed in the Affairs of the Muslims | C | 30312 |
| 4.32 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر خبر ثان يصرح بصحة ما ذكرناه</span> | A second report is mentioned, which confirms the validity of what we mentioned before. | C | 30314 |
| 4.33 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة كتمان العالم بعض ما يعلم من العلم إذا علم أن قلوب المستمعين له لا تحتمله</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of a scholar keeping some of his knowledge if he knows that the hearts of his listeners do not accept it | C | 30316 |
| 4.34 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن الأعمش لم يكن بالمنفرد في سماع هذا الخبر من عبد الله بن مرة دون غيره</span> | Mention of the clarification that al-A'mash was not alone in hearing this report from 'Abdullah ibn Murrah, excluding others | C | 30318 |
| 4.35 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر خبر ثان يصرح بصحة ما ذكرناه</span> | A second report is mentioned, which confirms the validity of what we mentioned before. | C | 30320 |
| 4.36 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر ما يستحب للمرء من ترك سرد الأحاديث حذر قلة التعظيم والتوقير لها</span> | Mention of what is recommended for a person to avoid narrating hadith out of disregard for its sanctity and reverence | C | 30322 |
| 4.37 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الإخبار عن إباحة جواب المرء بالكناية عما يسأل وإن كان في تلك الحالة مدحه</span> | Mention of the report regarding the permissibility of a person responding with an allusion to what he is asked, even if in that state it is praise | C | 30324 |
| 4.38 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على أن العالم عليه ترك التصلف بعلمه ولزوم الافتقار إلى الله جل وعلا في كل حاله</span> | Mention of the narration indicating that the scholar (*ʿālim*) should refrain from overreaching with his knowledge and should always seek reliance upon Allah, Exalted is He, in all circumstances | C | 30326 |
| 4.39 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة إجابة العالم السائل بالأجوبة على سبيل التشبيه والمقايسة دون الفصل في القصة</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of answering a questioner with answers through comparison and analogy, without distinguishing the story | C | 30328 |
| 4.40 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة إعفاء المسؤول عن العلم عن إجابة السائل على الفور</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of exempting a responsible person from knowledge from answering a questioner immediately | C | 30330 |
| 4.41 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الإباحة للعالم إذا سئل عن الشيء أن يغضي عن الإجابة مدة ثم يجيب ابتداء منه</span> | The permission for the scholar if he is asked about something to delay his answer for a while then answer starting from it | C | 30332 |
| 4.42 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة إلقاء العالم على تلاميذه المسائل التي يريد أن يعلمهم إياها</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of a scholar throwing questions on his students that he wants to teach them | C | 30334 |
| 4.43 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على أن المصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم قد كان يعرض له الأحوال في بعض الأحايين</span> | "The chapter on the narration indicating that the Chosen One (ṣallallāhu ‘alayhi wa-sallam) would sometimes be shown his future states." | C | 30336 |
| 4.44 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة اعتراض المتعلم على العالم فيما يعلمه من العلم</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of a student objecting to a scholar about what he teaches | C | 30338 |
| 4.45 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الإباحة للمرء أن يسأل عن الشيء وهو خبير به من غير أن يكون ذاك به استهزاء</span> | Mention of the permissibility for a man to ask about something he is knowledgeable about without it being in mockery | C | 30340 |
| 4.46 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الإخبار عما يجب على المرء من ترك التكلف في دين الله بما تنكب عنه وأغضي عن إبدائه</span> | The narration of what a person should do to abandon burdening Allah's religion with what is revealed about it and hiding its manifestation | C | 30342 |
| 4.47 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر الدال على إباحة إظهار المرء بعض ما يحسن من العلم إذا صحت نيته في إظهاره</span> | The report indicating the permissibility of a person showing some of his good knowledge if his intention in showing it is correct | C | 30344 |
| 4.48 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الحكم فيمن دعا إلى هدى أو ضلالة فاتبع عليه</span> | The narration states the ruling for one who calls to guidance or misguidance and follows the latter. | C | 30346 |
| 4.49 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن على العالم أن لا يقنط عباد الله عن رحمة الله</span> | "The clarification that the scholar must never despair of Allāh’s mercy for His servants." | C | 30348 |
| 4.50 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إباحة تأليف العالم كتب الله جل وعلا</span> | Mention of the permissibility of a scholar compiling the Books of Allah, the Exalted | C | 30350 |
| 4.51 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الحث على تعليم كتاب الله وإن لم يتعلم الإنسان بالتمام</span> | The narration states the exhortation to teach the Qurʾān, even if not fully memorized. | C | 30352 |
| 4.52 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الإخبار عما يجب على المرء من تعلم كتاب الله جل وعلا واتباع ما فيه عند وقوع الفتن خاصة</span> | The narration of what a person should do to learn the Book of Allah, the Most High, and follow what is in it, especially during the times of fitna | C | 30355 |
| 4.53 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن من خير الناس من تعلم القرآن وعلمه</span> | Mention of the clarification that among the best of people are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it | C | 30357 |
| 4.54 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الأمر باقتناء القرآن مع تعليمه</span> | Mention of the Command to Acquire the Quran Along With Teaching It | C | 30359 |
| 4.55 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن أن لا يستغني المرء بما أوتي من كتاب الله جل وعلا</span> | Mention the prohibition of relying solely on what is given to a person from the Book of Allah, the Most High. | C | 30361 |
| 4.56 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر وصف من أعطي القرآن والإيمان أو أعطي أحدهما دون الآخر</span> | Mention of the description of those who are given the Quran and faith, or given one of them without the other | C | 30363 |
| 4.57 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر نفي الضلال عن الآخذ بالقرآن</span> | Mention of the negation of misguidance from the one who adheres to the Quran | C | 30365 |
| 4.58 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إثبات الهدى لمن اتبع القرآن والضلالة لمن تركه</span> | Mentioning the confirmation of guidance for one who follows the Quran and the rejection of those who abandon it | C | 30367 |
| 4.59 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن القرآن من جعله إمامه بالعمل قاده إلى الجنة ومن جعله وراء ظهره بترك العمل ساقه إلى النار</span> | Mention of the clarification that the Qur'an, for the one who makes it his leader through action, leads him to Paradise, and for the one who places it behind his back by abandoning action, drives him to the Fire | C | 30369 |
| 4.60 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إباحة الحسد لمن أوتي كتاب الله تعالى فقام به آناء الليل والنهار</span> | Mention of the permissibility of envying one who has been granted the Book of Allah and stands by it day and night | C | 30371 |
| 4.61 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم فهو ينفق منه آناء الليل وآناء النهار أراد به فهو يتصدق به</span> | Clarification that the statement of the Prophet (peace be upon him), 'Then he spends from it at times during the night and at times during the day,' refers to then he gives charity with it. | C | 30373 |
| 4.62 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر المدحض قول من زعم أن الخلفاء الراشدين والكبار من الصحابة غير جائز أن يخفى عليهم بعض أحكام الوضوء والصلاة</span> | Mention of the report refuting the statement of those who claimed that the Rightly Guided Caliphs and the major Companions are not allowed to be unaware of some of the rulings of ablution and prayer | C | 30375 |

| 19.13 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر المدحض قول من زعم أن هذا الخبر تفرد به أيوب السختياني</span> | Mentioned the refuted report: Whoever claims that this report was exclusively narrated by Ayyub Al-Sakhtiani | C | 38738 |
| 19.14 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر المدحض قول من زعم أن هذا الخبر ما رواه إلا نافع عن ابن عمر</span> | Mention of the report refuting the claim of those who alleged that this report was narrated only by Nāfi' from Ibn 'Umar | C | 38740 |
| 19.15 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن المرء مخير عند استثنائه في اليمين بين أن يترك يمينه أو يمضي فيها</span> | The clarification that a person, when exempted from an oath, has the choice between abandoning his oath or fulfilling it. | C | 38742 |

| 36.5 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن الظالم الشبر من الأرض فما فوقه يكلف حفرها إلى أسفل من سبع أرضين بنفسه ثم يطوق إياها ذلك</span> | Mention of the clarification that the one who wrongfully takes a span of land or more will be made to dig it to the bottom of the seven earths himself, then it will be placed around his neck | C | 40412 |
| 36.6 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر إيجاب دخول النار لمن ظلم أخاه المسلم على شيء من ماله أرضا كان أو غيرها وإن كان ذلك الشيء يسيرا تافها</span> | Mention of the merit of entering the Fire for the one who oppresses his Muslim brother over something from his wealth, whether it is land or something else, even if that thing is small and insignificant. | C | 40414 |
| 36.7 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الأمر برد الظالم عن ظلمه ونصرة المظلوم إذ رد الظالم عن ظلمه نصرته</span> | Mention of the command to return the oppressor from his oppression and support the oppressed when the oppressor is returned from his oppression, it is a support for him | C | 40416 |
| 36.8 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر خبر ثان يصرح بصحة ما ذكرناه</span> | A second report is mentioned, which confirms the validity of what we mentioned before. | C | 40418 |
| 36.9 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الأمر للمرء بنصرة الظالم والمظلوم معا إذا قدر المرء على ذلك</span> | Mention of the command for a person to aid both the oppressor and the oppressed if he is able to do so | C | 40420 |
| 36.10 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن النهبة للأشياء التي لا يملكها المرء</span> | Mention of admonition against seizing things that one does not own | C | 40422 |
| 36.11 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن انتهاب المرء مال أخيه المسلم</span> | Mention of admonition against seizing the property of one’s Muslim brother | C | 40424 |
| 36.12 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن احتلاب المرء ماشية أخيه المسلم بغير إذنه</span> | Warning against riding over another Muslim’s property without permission | C | 40426 |
| 36.13 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر نفي اسم الإيمان عن المنتهب النهبة إذا كانت ذات شرف</span> | Mention of the negation of the name of faith from the one who plunders a noble plunder | C | 40428 |
| 36.14 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الخبر المدحض قول من زعم أن ذكر النهبة تفرد به أبو بكر بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث في هذا الخبر</span> | The mention of the refuted report: [the claim] that the mention of *nahbah* (booty) in this narration was transmitted solely by Abū Bakr ibn ‘Abd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith | C | 40430 |
| 36.15 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر الزجر عن أخذ هذه الأموال من غير حلها لأحد من المسلمين</span> | Mention the prohibition of taking these monies from the Muslims without permission. | C | 40432 |
| 36.16 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر البيان بأن الله قد يمهل الظلمة والفساق إلى وقت قضاء أخذهم فإذا أخذهم أخذ بشدة نعوذ بالله منه</span> | Mention of the clarification that Allah may grant respite to the wrongdoers and the wicked until the time of their seizure, and when He seizes them, He seizes them severely—we seek refuge with Allah from that | C | 40434 |

<a id="al-mu-jam-al-awsat"></a>

## Al-Mu'jam al-Awsat / المعجم الأوسط

**Schema:** Alphabetical letter → given-name group → individual teacher → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">حرف المعجم ← مجموعة الاسم ← الشيخ ← الروايات</span>

Alphabetical teacher-based muʿjam, not topical books or Companion musnads. The source’s own [description](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/Book/Details?bookId=13) confirms the arrangement by teachers’ names.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=13&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 13; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 26; L2: 128. **Corpus reports:** 9,499.

<a id="sunan-al-daraqutni"></a>

## Sunan al-Daraqutni / سنن الدارقطني

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → bāb where supplied → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented Sunan. Some source root divisions lead directly to reports and have no separate lower heading.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=18&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 18; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 24; L2: 329. **Corpus reports:** 4,840.

<a id="al-mustadrak-ala-al-sahihayn"></a>

## Al-Mustadrak 'ala al-Sahihayn / المستدرك على الصحيحين

**Schema:** Introduction/topical kitāb → bāb or thematic heading → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented collection with nested divisions, including headings concerning named individuals. Those headings do not make the whole work a Companion-based musnad.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=24&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 24; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 55; L2: 2400. **Corpus reports:** 8,919.

| 2.25 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">شدة الاهتمام بصلاة الفجر والعصر</span> | "The importance of the *ṣalāt al-fajr* and *al-ʿaṣr* prayers" | C | 51065 |
| 2.26 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الإسلام أن تعبد الله ولا تشرك به شيئا وتقيم الصلاة وتؤتي الزكاة</span> | "Islam is that you worship Allah alone, associate nothing with Him, establish prayer, and give zakah" | C | 51069 |
| 2.27 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله من كنز الجنة</span> | There is no power or strength except by Allah—[He is] the Treasure of Paradise (*kanz al-jannah*). | C | 51071 |
| 2.28 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا زنى العبد خرج منه الإيمان</span> | When a servant fornicates, faith departs from him | C | 51074 |

| 2.30 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">حفت الجنة بالمكاره</span> | Paradise is surrounded by trials and tribulations | C | 51091 |
| 2.31 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تفسير آية وإذ أخذ ربك من بني آدم من ظهورهم ذريتهم</span> | The interpretation of the verse: And He took from the children of Adam from their loins their descendants | C | 51095 |
| 2.32 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">فضيلة لباس الصوف</span> | The Merit of Wearing Wool | C | 51098 |
| 2.33 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">بعث الجنة وبعث النار</span> | The Resurrection of Paradise and the Resurrection of Hellfire | C | 51101 |
| 2.34 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">اتقوا دعوات المظلوم</span> | Beware of the appeals of the oppressed | C | 51105 |
| 2.35 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لواء الحمد يوم القيامة معه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم</span> | The banner of praise on the Day of Resurrection will be with him, peace and blessings be upon him and his family | C | 51107 |
| 2.36 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أيما رجل خرج من بيته لا يريد إلا الصلاة يخرج من خطيئته كيوم ولدته أمه</span> | Which man, if he went out of his house not wanting anything but prayer, he will leave his sin as the day his mother bore him | C | 51109 |
| 2.37 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">هؤلاء للجنة ولا أبالي وهؤلاء للنار ولا أبالي</span> | These are for Paradise, and I care not; these are for Hellfire, and I care not | C | 51111 |

| 2.39 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الرقى والأدوية من قدر الله تعالى</span> | Incantations and medicines are from the decree of Allah the Exalted | C | 51116 |
| 2.40 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الطير تجري بقدر</span> | Birds move by decree | C | 51119 |
| 2.41 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يؤمن العبد حتى يؤمن بأربع</span> | A servant (*ʿabd*) will not have faith (*yūmin*) until he believes in four [articles]: Allah, His angels, His Books, and His Messengers. | C | 51121 |

| 2.44 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">هل للإسلام من منتهى</span> | Is there an end to Islam? | C | 51130 |
| 2.45 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">فضيلة كفاف العيش والقناعة</span> | The Merit of Living Frugally and Being Content | C | 51133 |
| 2.46 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">التعوذ من الكفر والفقر وعذاب القبر</span> | The expiation from disbelief, poverty, and the torment of the grave | C | 51135 |
| 2.47 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">هو صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم رحمة مهداة</span> | May Allah bless him and his family | C | 51137 |
| 2.48 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كيف يتعلم القرآن</span> | How is the Qur'an learned? | C | 51139 |
| 2.49 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ستة لعنهم الله وكل نبي مجاب</span> | Six whom Allah has cursed, and every Prophet is answered | C | 51141 |
| 2.50 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">جواب من سأل أين النار</span> | Response to a question about where the Fire is | C | 51143 |
| 2.51 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تبع وذو القرنين أكانا نبيين أم لا</span> | Following the *dhū al-qarnayn* (two horned ones)—were they prophets or not? | C | 51145 |
| 2.52 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقولة إبليس حين رأى صورة آدم عليه السلام</span> | The Statement of Iblīs When He Saw the Image of Adam (upon him be peace) | C | 51147 |
| 2.53 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">اتباع هذه الأمة سنن من قبلهم</span> | Following the customs of this nation from before | C | 51149 |
| 2.54 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مجيء ملك الموت عند قبض الروح وذكر ما يكون بعد ذلك في القبر للمؤمن والكافر</span> | The arrival of the Angel of Death at the time of the soul’s extraction and what occurs afterward in the grave for the believer and the disbeliever | C | 51151 |
| 2.55 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أشد الناس بلاء الأنبياء ثم العلماء ثم الصالحون</span> | The people most severely tested are the prophets, then the scholars, then the righteous | C | 51163 |
| 2.56 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا كان أجل أحد بأرض أثبت الله له إليها حاجة</span> | When the term of one's life is in a land, Allah establishes for him a need there | C | 51167 |
| 2.57 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">المؤمن غر كريم والفاجر خب لئيم</span> | The believer is generous and the sinner is stingy | C | 51174 |
| 2.58 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من قتل نفسا معاهدة بغير حقها حرم الله عليه الجنة</span> | Whoever kills a covenant-protected soul without right, Allah forbids him Paradise | C | 51180 |
| 2.59 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الرجل ليتكلم بالكلمة فيكتب الله له بها رضوانه إلى يوم يلقاه</span> | If a man would speak a word, Allah would write for him its reward until the Day he meets Him | C | 51189 |
| 2.60 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ويل للذي يحدث فيكذب ويضحك به القوم</span> | Woe to him who narrates and lies and the people laugh at him | C | 51191 |
| 2.61 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا ينبغي للمؤمن أن يكون لعانا</span> | A believer should not be stingy. | C | 51195 |
| 2.62 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يجتمع أن تكونوا لعانين صديقين</span> | You will not be hypocrites (*laʿānin*) and friends (*ṣadīqin*) simultaneously (*yajmaʿu*). | C | 51198 |
| 2.63 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">قال لا تلاعنوا بلعنة الله ولا بغضب الله ولا بالنار</span> | Do not curse with the curse of Allāh, nor with His anger, nor with the Fire | C | 51202 |
| 2.64 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله كريم يحب الكرم ومعالي الأخلاق ويبغض سفسافها</span> | Indeed, Allah is Generous; He loves generosity and noble manners, and He detests ignoble ones. | C | 51204 |

| 2.66 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الطاعون شهادة</span> | The plague is martyrdom | C | 51213 |
| 2.67 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من لعب بالنرد فقد عصى الله ورسوله</span> | Whoever plays with dice has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger ﷺ | C | 51216 |
| 2.68 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن خيار عباد الله الذين يراعون الشمس والقمر والنجوم والأظلة لذكر الله</span> | Indeed, the best of Allah’s servants are those who observe the sun, the moon, the stars, and the shades for the remembrance of Allah. | C | 51220 |
| 2.69 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">شعائر الدين</span> | Religious rites | C | 51223 |
| 2.70 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من حلف بشيء دون الله فقد أشرك</span> | Whoever swore by something other than Allah, he has associated | C | 51226 |
| 2.71 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الحياء من الإيمان</span> | Modesty is from faith | C | 51230 |
| 2.72 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من أكمل المؤمنين إيمانا أحسنهم خلقا وألطفهم بأهله</span> | Whoever completed the believers in faith, they were the best in character and the gentlest with their families | C | 51234 |
| 2.73 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">خالق الناس بخلق حسن</span> | The Creator of people with good creation. | C | 51240 |
| 2.74 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الوصية لمن أراد سفرا</span> | Bequeathing to one intending to travel | C | 51242 |
| 2.75 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كل أمتي يدخل الجنة إلا من أبى</span> | All of My Ummah Will Enter Paradise Except Those Who Refuse | C | 51246 |
| 2.76 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن لله مائة رحمة قسم منها رحمة بين أهل الدنيا</span> | Indeed, Allah has one hundred mercies, from which He has allocated one mercy among the people of the world. | C | 51250 |
| 2.77 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن جبرائيل كان يدس في فم فرعون الطين</span> | Indeed, Gabriel used to stuff clay into the mouth of Pharaoh. | C | 51254 |
| 2.78 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من نوقش الحساب هلك</span> | Those whose accounts are disputed, perish | C | 51257 |
| 2.79 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الكيس من دان لنفسه وعمل لما بعد الموت</span> | The chapter on: The wise person is he who accounts himself (to Allāh) and prepares for the Hereafter | C | 51259 |
| 2.80 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">المؤمن مكفر</span> | The believer is forgiven | C | 51261 |
| 2.81 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تحشر هذه الأمة على ثلاثة أصناف</span> | This Ummah Will Be Divided into Three Groups | C | 51263 |
| 2.82 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الله لا يلقي حبيبه في النار</span> | The chapter on: Allāh does not cast His beloved into the Fire | C | 51265 |
| 2.83 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يمل الله حتى تملوا</span> | Allah does not become tired until you become tired. | C | 51267 |
| 2.84 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن أولياء الله المصلون</span> | If the servants of Allah are the ones who pray | C | 51270 |
| 2.85 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أي آية في كتاب الله أرجى</span> | Which verse in the Book of Allah do I seek refuge in | C | 51272 |
| 2.86 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله ليبلغ العبد بحسن خلقه درجة الصوم والصلاة</span> | Indeed, Allah elevates a servant through his good character to the rank of fasting and prayer. | C | 51274 |
| 2.87 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من يتعاظم في نفسه ويختال في مشيته إلا لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان</span> | Those who boast in themselves and are careless in their walking, except that they meet Allah while He is angry with them | C | 51277 |
| 2.88 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أهل الجنة المغلوبون الضعفاء وأهل النار كل جعظري جواظ مستكبر</span> | The people of Paradise are the oppressed and weak, while the people of Hell are every arrogant, harsh, and proud person | C | 51279 |
| 2.89 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم يركب الحمار ويلبس الصوف</span> | The Messenger of Allah would ride a donkey and wear wool. | C | 51282 |
| 2.90 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من ترك اللباس وهو قادر عليه تواضعا لله خيره الله في حلل الإيمان</span> | Whoever abandons clothing while able to do so out of humility for Allāh, Allāh will adorn him with the garments of faith | C | 51285 |
| 2.91 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">قصة خروج عمر إلى الشام وقوله إنا قوم أعزنا الله بالإسلام فلن نبتغي العزة بغيره</span> | The story of Umar's exit to Sham and his saying, 'We are a people whom Allah has honored with Islam; we will not seek honor from anyone else' | C | 51287 |
| 2.92 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ليس منا من لم يرحم صغيرنا ويعرف حق كبيرنا</span> | He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young and recognize the rights of our elders | C | 51290 |
| 2.93 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">البركة مع أكابركم</span> | Blessing is with your upper limbs (i.e., eating with the right hand) | C | 51292 |
| 2.94 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إني أحرج عليكم حق الضعيفين اليتيم والمرأة</span> | Indeed, I make it forbidden for you to violate the rights of the two weak ones: the orphan and the woman. | C | 51294 |
| 2.95 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">التؤدة في كل شيء خير إلا في عمل الآخرة</span> | The benefit in everything is good except in the work of the Hereafter | C | 51297 |
| 2.96 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">قصة خلق آدم وجعله من عمره ستين سنة لداود عليهما السلام</span> | The story of the creation of Adam and his being made sixty years old for David (peace be upon him) | C | 51299 |
| 2.97 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">هل رأى محمد صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ربه</span> | Did Muḥammad ﷺ see his Lord? | C | 51302 |
| 2.98 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">للأنبياء منابر من ذهب</span> | The prophets have pulpits of gold | C | 51307 |
| 2.99 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الشفاعة لكل مسلم</span> | Intercession for every Muslim | C | 51309 |
| 2.100 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">اختار النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم الشفاعة على أن يدخل شطر أمته الجنة</span> | The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, Chose Intercession Over Half of His Ummah Entering Paradise | C | 51314 |
| 2.101 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم اختبأ دعوته شفاعة لأمته يوم القيامة</span> | Indeed, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) concealed his supplication as an intercession for his community on the Day of Resurrection. | C | 51316 |
| 2.102 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">شفاعتي لأهل الكبائر من أمتي</span> | My intercession for the great sinners of my nation | C | 51319 |
| 2.103 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">شفاعتي لمن شهد أن لا إله إلا الله مخلصا يصدق قلبه لسانه ولسانه قلبه</span> | My intercession for those who testify that there is no god but Allah, sincerely, with their hearts, tongues, and tongues their hearts | C | 51325 |
| 2.104 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">يقول الله تعالى أخرجوا من النار من ذكرني أو خافني في مقام</span> | Allah says, 'Bring out from the fire those who mentioned me or feared me in their place' | C | 51327 |
| 2.105 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ليدخلن الجنة بشفاعة رجل من أمتي أكثر من بني تميم</span> | More people from the tribe of Banu Tamim will enter Paradise through the intercession of a man from my nation | C | 51330 |
| 2.106 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ما من مسلمين يعدمان ثلاثة لم يبلغوا الحنث إلا أدخلهما الله الجنة بفضل رحمة الله</span> | There is no two Muslims who lose three children who have not reached puberty except that Allah will enter them into Paradise by His mercy | C | 51333 |
| 2.107 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا كان يوم القيامة كان النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم إمام النبيين وخطيبهم</span> | When the Day of Resurrection comes, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, will be the leader of the prophets and their orator | C | 51336 |
| 2.108 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من قال لا إله إلا الله حقا من قلبه حرمه الله على النار</span> | Whoever said: 'Whoever says 'There is no god but Allah' sincerely from his heart, Allah forbids the Fire for him' | C | 51339 |
| 2.109 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من علم أن الصلاة عليه حق واجب دخل الجنة</span> | Whoever knows that prayer is an obligatory right upon him will enter Paradise | C | 51341 |
| 2.110 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ثلاثة لا يدخلون الجنة العاق بوالديه والديوث ورجلة النساء</span> | Three who will not enter Paradise: the adulterer, the fornicator, and the woman who commits adultery | C | 51343 |
| 2.111 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مثل الإسلام وحدود الله</span> | The example of Islam and the boundaries of Allah | C | 51345 |
| 2.112 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مثل العبد المؤمن حين يصيبه الحمى</span> | The example of the believing slave when fever afflicts him | C | 51347 |
| 2.113 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الحمى تذهب الذنوب</span> | Fever removes sins | C | 51349 |
| 2.114 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الأخلاء ثلاثة</span> | The **three (types of) expiation (ḥalāʾ).** | C | 51351 |
| 2.115 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">يتبع المؤمن بعد موته ثلاثة</span> | Three things will follow the believer after death | C | 51353 |
| 2.116 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">جواز تعلم كتابة اليهود</span> | Permission to learn the writing of the Jews | C | 51357 |
| 2.117 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">صفة حوضه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم وعلامات الساعات</span> | The description of the Prophet’s ﷺ Pool (*al-Ḥawḍ*) and the signs of the hours | C | 51359 |
| 2.118 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من خرج من الجماعة قيد شبر فقد خلع ربقة الإسلام من عنقه حتى يراجعه</span> | Whoever left the congregation with a span's length, he has removed the garland of Islam from his neck until he returns | C | 51366 |
| 2.119 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من دخل على أمراء فصدقهم بكذبهم وأعانهم على ظلمهم ليس بوارد على الحوض</span> | Whoever entered upon rulers and believed them with their lies and aided them in their oppression, he is not a ward on the pool | C | 51370 |
| 2.120 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الجنة مائة درجة والفردوس من أعلاها درجة فاسألوه الفردوس</span> | "Chapter: Paradise Has One Hundred Degrees, with Firdaws Being Its Highest Degree—Ask About Firdaws" | C | 51376 |
| 2.121 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر سدرة المنتهى وأنهار الجنة</span> | Mention of the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary and the rivers of Paradise | C | 51381 |
| 2.122 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أهل الجنة عشرون ومائة صف هذه الأمة منها ثمانون صفا</span> | The people of Paradise are one hundred and twenty rows, eighty of which are from this nation | C | 51384 |
| 2.123 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">يذبح الموت على الصراط</span> | Death will be slaughtered on the Ṣirāṭ | C | 51389 |
| 2.124 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان من ذهب ومن فضة</span> | For one who fears his Lord, **two gardens of gold and silver** | C | 51394 |
| 2.125 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">يوم القيامة كقدر ما بين الظهر والعصر للمؤمنين</span> | The Day of Judgment is as much as the time between Dhuhr and Asr for the believers | C | 51396 |
| 2.126 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">سيكون في أمتي أقوام يكذبون بالقدر</span> | Chapter: There Will Be in My Nation People Who Will Deny Predestination | C | 51399 |
| 2.127 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">القدرية مجوس هذه الأمة</span> | The Qadariyyah are the Magians of this Ummah | C | 51401 |
| 2.128 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا تجالسوا أهل القدر</span> | Do not sit with the people of qadar (predestinationists) | C | 51403 |

| 4.59 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يمتشط أحدنا كل يوم أو يبول في مغتسله</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade shaving every day or urinating in his bathwater | C | 51845 |

| 6.1 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا توضأ أحدكم في بيته ثم أتـى المسجد كان في صلاة</span> | When one of you performs ablution at home and then comes to the mosque, he is in a state of prayer | C | 52040 |
| 6.2 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا توضأت ثم دخلت المسجد فلا تشبكن بين أصابعك</span> | When you perform ablution and then enter the mosque, do not interlace your fingers | C | 52042 |
| 6.3 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فليصل على النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم</span> | When one of you enters the mosque, let him send blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family | C | 52045 |
| 6.4 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كان إذا دخل في الصلاة يقول اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الشيطان الرجيم وهمزه ونفخه ونفثه</span> | When he entered prayer, he would say, 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the accursed Shaytan, the rejected, the blown away, and the blown out.' | C | 52048 |
| 6.5 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الصلاة في الجماعة تعدل خمسا وعشرين صلاة فإذا صلاها في الفلاة فأتمها بلغت خمسين صلاة</span> | Prayer in congregation equals twenty-five prayers; if they pray them in the flutes, it completes them to fifty prayers | C | 52053 |
| 6.6 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا تمنعوا نساءكم المساجد وبيوتهن خير لهن</span> | Do not prevent your women from (going to) the mosques, though their homes are better for them | C | 52056 |

| 6.9 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من أم قوما فأصاب الوقت فله ولهم ومن انتقص من ذلك شيئا فعليه ولا عليهم</span> | Whoever raised a people and the time came, he had for himself and for them; and whoever subtracted from that, it was upon him and not upon them | C | 52063 |

| 6.27 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تطويل الدعاء في سجود تلاوة القرآن وتكراره صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم يا حي يا قيوم لا يزيد عليه شيئا</span> | "Lengthening supplication in prostration during Qurʾān recitation; the Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam) did not add to it: *‘O Ever-Living, O Sustainer!’*" | C | 52131 |

| 6.35 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله عن نقرة الغراب وافتراش السبع وأن يوطن الرجل المكان كما يوطنه البعير</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade the crow's squawking and the goat's chewing, and he forbade a man from staying in a place as a goat does | C | 52164 |

| 6.38 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا صلى أحدكم فليبدأ بتحميد ربه والثناء عليه وليصل على النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم</span> | When one of you prays, let him begin by praising his Lord and glorifying Him, and send blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family | C | 52174 |

| 6.41 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن رسول الله قرأ في الصلاة بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم فعدها آية</span> | Indeed, the Messenger of Allah recited 'In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate' in prayer and counted it as a verse. | C | 52185 |

| 6.43 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الحديث الموضوع عن أنس في الجهر ببسم الله الرحمن الرحيم في الصلاة</span> | Chapter: The Fabricated Narration Attributed to Anas Regarding the Loud Recitation of *Bismillāh ir-Rahmān ir-Rahīm* in Prayer | C | 52194 |

| 6.45 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن أحدكم إذا قام يصلي إنما يقوم يناجي ربه فلينظر كيف يناجيه</span> | If anyone of you stands to pray, he is indeed standing to invoke his Lord, so let him consider how he invokes Him | C | 52202 |
| 6.46 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يزال الله مقبلا على العبد ما لم يلتفت فإذا صرف وجهه انصرف عنه</span> | Allah remains accepting of the servant’s repentance as long as he does not turn away. If he turns away, Allah turns away from him. | C | 52204 |

| 6.49 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا قرأ الإمام فلا تقرؤوا إلا بأم القرآن فإنه لا صلاة لمن لم يقرأ بها</span> | When the Imam recites, do not recite except with 'Al-Fatihah,' for there is no prayer for one who does not recite it | C | 52217 |

| 6.54 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الأمر بالاطمئنان واعتدال الأركان في الصلاة</span> | The Command to Be Calm and Upright in the Prayer's Pillars | C | 52232 |

| 6.59 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من سمع النداء فلم يأته فلا صلاة له إلا من عذر</span> | Whoever hears the call to prayer but does not respond to it has no prayer except for a valid excuse | C | 52250 |
| 6.60 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من سمع الصلاة ينادى بها صحيحا من غير عذر فلم يأتها لم يقبل الله له صلاة في غيرها</span> | Who heard the prayer being called correctly without excuse and did not reach it; his prayer in the other was not accepted by Allah | C | 52254 |
| 6.61 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا صلاة لجار المسجد إلا في المسجد</span> | There is no prayer (*ṣalāh*) for a neighbor of the mosque (*jār al-masjid*) except in the mosque itself. | C | 52256 |
| 6.62 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ما من ثلاثة في قرية ولا في بدو لا تقام فيهم الصلاة إلا قد استحوذ عليهم الشيطان فعليك بالجماعة</span> | There is no group of three in a village or in the desert where prayer is not established except that Satan has taken control of them, so adhere to the congregation | C | 52259 |
| 6.63 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تأكيده صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم في صلاة العشاء</span> | Affirmation by the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the *ʿisha* (pre-dawn meal). | C | 52262 |
| 6.64 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أثقل الصلوات على المنافقين العشاء والصبح</span> | The heaviest prayers for hypocrites are the evening (Maghrib) and dawn (Fajr) prayers | C | 52265 |
| 6.65 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى أن يصلى في لحاف لا يتوشح به ونهى أن يصلي الرجل في سراويل وليس عليه رداء</span> | He forbade praying in a shroud that is not used for shrouding and forbade the man from praying in trousers without a robe | C | 52275 |
| 6.66 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">تصلي المرأة في درع وخمار ليس عليها إزار إذا كان الدرع سابغا يغطي ظهور قدميها</span> | "A woman may pray in a *diraʿ* (leather cloak) and *khimār* (veil) without an *iẓār* (wrap) if the *diraʿ* covers the tops of her feet" | C | 52277 |
| 6.67 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا تقبل صلاة حائض إلا بخمار</span> | The prayer of a menstruating woman is not accepted except with a khimār (head-covering) | C | 52280 |
| 6.68 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الأرض كلها مسجد إلا الحمام والمقبرة</span> | "The entire earth is a mosque except for the bathroom and the graveyard." | C | 52283 |
| 6.69 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا تصلوا إلا إلى سترة ولا تدع أحدا يمر بين يديك</span> | Do not pray except towards a sutrah, and do not let anyone pass in front of you | C | 52286 |

| 6.72 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ليستر أحدكم صلاته ولو بسهم</span> | Let one of you conceal his prayer, even if only with an arrow | C | 52293 |
| 6.73 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أمرنا أن نسبح في دبر كل صلاة ثلاثا وثلاثين ونحمد ثلاثا وثلاثين ونكبر أربعا وثلاثين</span> | We were commanded to glorify Allah thirty-three times, praise Him thirty-three times, and exalt Him thirty-four times after each prayer | C | 52297 |

| 6.75 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا صلى أحدكم في ثوب واحد فليشده على حقوه ولا تشتملوا كاشتمال اليهود</span> | When one of you prays in a single garment, let him tie it around his waist, and do not wrap yourselves like the Jews | C | 52301 |

| 6.83 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله بعث إلينا محمدا صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ولا نعلم شيئا فإنما نفعل كما رأينا محمدا يفعل</span> | If Allah sent us Muhammad peace be upon him and his household, and we do not know anything, we only do as we see Muhammad doing | C | 52325 |

| 19.125 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الذكر عند الاضطجاع والدعاء عند اليقظة</span> | Remembrance (*dhikr*) when lying down and supplication (*du‘ā’*) upon waking | C | 53858 |
| 19.126 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">دعاء عيادة المريض</span> | The supplication for visiting the sick | C | 53860 |
| 19.127 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">دعاء الشفاء للمريض عند العيادة</span> | The supplication for healing the sick during the visit | C | 53862 |
| 19.128 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">رغم أنف رجل لم يصل على النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم</span> | Despite a man's nose not reaching the Prophet (ﷺ) | C | 53864 |
| 19.129 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ما جلس قوم يذكرون الله ولم يصلوا على نبيهم صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم إلا كان ذلك كان المجلس ترة عليهم</span> | No group of people sit remembering Allah without sending blessings upon their Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa ālihi wa sallam) except that their gathering will be a cause of regret for them | C | 53867 |

#### 21. كتاب البيوع

[Source division](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=24&ParentId=54036&IsLeaf=False).

| # | Arabic source heading | English rendering | Basis | Node ID |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|
| 21.1 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا بأس بالغنى لمن اتقى</span> | There is no harm in wealth for one who is God-fearing | C | 54038 |
| 21.2 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">خذوا ما حل ودعوا ما حرم</span> | Take What is Lawful and Leave What is Unlawful | C | 54041 |
| 21.3 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لم يكن عبد ليموت حتى يبلغ آخر رزق هو له</span> | No servant dies until he reaches the last provision destined for him | C | 54043 |
| 21.4 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله لا ينال فضله بمعصية</span> | Indeed, Allah’s favor is not attained through disobedience. | C | 54046 |
| 21.5 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">البيع يحضره الكذب واليمين فشوبوه بالصدقة</span> | Sale accompanied by falsehood and truth, so replace it with charity | C | 54049 |
| 21.6 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">التاجر الصدوق الأمين المسلم مع الشهداء يوم القيامة</span> | The honest trader, the trustworthy, the Muslim, with the martyrs on the Day of Judgment | C | 54054 |
| 21.7 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن من أشراط الساعة أن يفيض المال ويكثر الجهل</span> | Indeed, among the signs of the Hour is the overflow of wealth and the increase of ignorance. | C | 54060 |
| 21.8 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن خير البقاع المساجد وإن شر البقاع الأسواق</span> | Indeed, the best of places are the mosques, and the worst of places are the markets. | C | 54062 |
| 21.9 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا تختلفوا فتختلف قلوبكم</span> | Do not differ, lest your hearts differ | C | 54065 |
| 21.10 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يحل لمسلم إن باع من أخيه بيعا فيه عيب أن لا يبينه له</span> | It is not permissible for a Muslim to sell to his brother a defective item without disclosing its flaw. | C | 54068 |
| 21.11 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ليس منا من غشنا</span> | He is not one of us who deceives us | C | 54070 |
| 21.12 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ليأتين على الناس زمان لا يبقى فيه أحد إلا أكل الربا</span> | There will come a time for the people when no one will remain except that he consumes usury | C | 54080 |
| 21.13 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يحتكر إلا خاطئ</span> | Only a sinner engages in *iḥtikār* (hoarding/artificial scarcity). | C | 54082 |
| 21.14 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الجالب إلى سوقنا كالمجاهد في سبيل الله</span> | One Who Brings Goods to Our Market is Like One Who Fights in the Path of Allah | C | 54088 |
| 21.15 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">دع ما يريبك إلى ما لا يريبك فإن الخير طمأنينة وإن الشر ريبة</span> | Avoid what worries you and turn to what does not worry you, for good is reassurance and evil is doubt | C | 54091 |
| 21.16 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا سرتك حسنتك وساءتك سيئتك فأنت مؤمن</span> | When your good deeds please you and your evil deeds displease you, you are a believer | C | 54094 |
| 21.17 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">البر حسن الخلق والإثم ما حاك في صدرك</span> | Goodness is excellent character, while evil is what lurks in your heart | C | 54096 |
| 21.18 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الخراج بالضمان</span> | The Crop Due to Guarantee | C | 54101 |
| 21.19 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">البيعان بالخيار ما لم يتفرقا ويأخذ كل واحد منهما من البيع ما يهوى</span> | Sale with an option, if they do not separate, each takes from the sale what he likes | C | 54108 |
| 21.20 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">اشتراط البائع خدمة العبد المبيع وقتا معلوما</span> | The **seller** may demand that the **servant** be served (worked) at a **predefined time**. | C | 54110 |
| 21.21 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يجوز بيعان في بيع ولا بيع ما لا يملك ولا سلف وبيع ولا شرطان في بيع</span> | It is not permissible to sell two things in a single sale, nor to sell what one does not own, nor to sell on credit with a deferred payment, nor to include two conditions in a single sale. | C | 54114 |
| 21.22 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن بيع الحب حتى يشتد وعن بيع العنب حتى يسود وعن بيع التمر حتى يحمر ويصفر</span> | The prohibition of selling dates until they turn red and yellow, and wine until it is strong, and honey until it is thick | C | 54123 |
| 21.23 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كفى بالمرء من الكذب أن يحدث بكل ما سمع</span> | It is Sufficient as a Lie for a Man to Narrate Everything He Hears | C | 54128 |
| 21.24 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا عهدة فوق أربع</span> | There is no oath (*ʿahd*) exceeding four [days or nights]. | C | 54132 |
| 21.25 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">عهدة الرقيق أربع ليال</span> | The Liability for Slaves is Four Nights | C | 54134 |
| 21.26 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ما من عبد كانت له نية في أداء دينه إلا كان له من الله عون</span> | There is no servant who has the intention to fulfill his debt except that Allah will aid him | C | 54137 |
| 21.27 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله مع الدائن حتى يقضي دينه ما لم يكن فيما يكرهه الله</span> | Indeed, Allah is with the creditor until he settles his debt, provided it is not in what Allah dislikes. | C | 54141 |
| 21.28 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من تداين بدين وليس في نفسه وفاؤه ثم مات اقتص الله لغريمه عنه يوم القيامة</span> | Whoever borrows a debt without the ability to repay it, then dies, Allāh will exact it from him on the Day of Resurrection | C | 54143 |
| 21.29 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الدين راية الله في الأرض فإذا أراد أن يذل عبدا وضعها في عنقه</span> | Religion is the banner of Allah on Earth; when He wills to humiliate a servant, He takes it from his neck | C | 54148 |
| 21.30 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لو قتل رجل في سبيل الله ثم عاش وعليه دين ما دخل الجنة حتى يقضى دينه</span> | If a man is killed in the path of Allah and then comes back to life with debt, he will not enter Paradise until his debt is paid | C | 54151 |
| 21.31 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من مات وهو بريء من ثلاث الكبر والغلول والدين دخل الجنة</span> | Whoever dies free from three things—major sins, usury (riba), and debt—will enter Paradise | C | 54157 |
| 21.32 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن إبليس يئس أن تعبد الأصنام بأرض العرب</span> | If Satan is despairing that idols are worshiped in the land of the Arabs | C | 54162 |
| 21.33 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من حالت شفاعته دون حد من حدود الله فقد ضاد الله في أمره ومن خاصم في باطل</span> | Whoever's intercession was limited by a boundary of Allah, Allah has opposed in his matter, and whoever accused falsely | C | 54164 |
| 21.34 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">حكاية رجل لم يعمل خيرا قط وكان يداين الناس بالمسامحة</span> | The story of a man who never did any good deed but always forgave others’ debts | C | 54166 |
| 21.35 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من أنظر معسرا ووضع له أظله الله في ظله</span> | Whoever looked at a poor person and Allah placed his shade in his shade | C | 54168 |
| 21.36 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ومن وجدتموه معسرا فتجاوزوا عنه</span> | "And if you find him in hardship, then overlook it (i.e., forgive the debt)" | C | 54171 |
| 21.37 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن خير القوم خيرهم قضاء</span> | Indeed, the best of people are those who are best in fulfilling obligations. | C | 54175 |
| 21.38 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">زن وأرجح</span> | ‘Zan and ‘Arrajah (both narrators, with preference given to one over the other) | C | 54177 |
| 21.39 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن كسر سكة المسلمين الجائزة</span> | The prohibition of breaking the path of the Muslims who are being rewarded | C | 54181 |
| 21.40 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله لعن الخمر وعاصرها ومعتصرها وشاربها</span> | Indeed, Allah has cursed wine, its presser, the one for whom it is pressed, and its drinker. | C | 54183 |
| 21.41 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من طلب حقا فليطلب في عفاف</span> | Whoever seeks a right should seek it with chastity | C | 54188 |
| 21.42 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن ثمن الكلب ومهر البغي وأجر الكاهن وكسب الحجام</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade the price of the dog, the dowry of the adulterer, the fee of the priest, and the earnings of the barber | C | 54193 |
| 21.43 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن لبن الجلالة وعن أكل المجثمة وعن الشرب من في السقاء</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade the milk of the gazelle, eating the liver, and drinking from the siphon | C | 54199 |
| 21.44 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن بيع الشاة باللحم</span> | The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, forbade selling the sheep by its meat | C | 54204 |
| 21.45 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من اشترى سرقة وهو يعلم أنها سرقة فقد شرك في عارها وإثمها</span> | Whoever purchases stolen goods knowing them to be stolen has thereby shared in their shame and sin. | C | 54207 |
| 21.46 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أيما رجل باع بيعا من رجل أو رجلين فهو للأول منهما وأيما امرأة زوجها وليان فهي للأول منهما</span> | Which man, if he sold a sale from a man or two men, it is for the first of them, and which woman, if she married two witnesses, it is for the first of them | C | 54209 |
| 21.47 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا سرق الرجل فوجد سرقته فهو أحق بها حيث وجدها</span> | When a man steals and his stolen property is found with him, he is more entitled to it wherever it is found | C | 54211 |
| 21.48 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">بم يستحل أحدكم مال أخيه إن أصابته جائحة من السماء</span> | By what means does one of you deem lawful the property of his brother if a calamity from the sky befalls it? | C | 54213 |
| 21.49 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن أربى الربا عرض الرجل المسلم</span> | If riba is widespread, the Muslim man is exposed | C | 54217 |
| 21.50 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا ظهر الزنا والربا في قرية فقد أحلوا بأنفسهم عذاب الله</span> | When fornication and usury become manifest in a village, they have permitted upon themselves the punishment of Allah | C | 54220 |
| 21.51 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الربا وإن كثر عاقبته تصير إلى قل</span> | Usury, even if it is much, its punishment becomes nothing | C | 54222 |
| 21.52 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن بيع الصبرة من التمر لا يعلم مكيلها بالكيل المسمى من التمر</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade selling the safflower date without knowing its measure by the named measure of dates | C | 54224 |
| 21.53 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن بيع الرطب بالتمر</span> | The prohibition of selling wet dates | C | 54226 |
| 21.54 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ترفع للرجل صحيفة يوم القيامة حتى يرى أنه ناج فما تزال مظالم بني آدم تتبعه حتى ما تبقى له حسنة</span> | A Man’s Record Will Be Raised on the Day of Resurrection Until He Sees That He Is Saved, Yet the Wrongs of the Children of Adam Will Follow Him Until Only Good Remains for Him | C | 54231 |
| 21.55 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن الجلالة أن يؤكل لحمها ويشرب لبنها</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade eating the meat of the gazelle and drinking its milk | C | 54233 |
| 21.56 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم أن تباع السلع حيث تبتاع حتى يحوزها التجار إلى رحالهم</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade selling goods where they are sold until the merchants reach their caravans | C | 54236 |
| 21.57 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن كل ذي ناب من السباع وعن قتل الولدان</span> | The Messenger of Allah forbade all animals with horns and the killing of the twins | C | 54238 |
| 21.58 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كسب الحجام خبيث</span> | The barber is a liar | C | 54245 |
| 21.59 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن كسب الأمة إلا ما عملت بيدها نحو الغزل والخبز والنفش</span> | The prohibition of earning the nation except what it has worked with its hands, such as weaving, baking, and spinning | C | 54247 |
| 21.60 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن كسب الأمة حتى يعلم من أين هو</span> | The prohibition of earning the nation until it is known from where it is | C | 54249 |
| 21.61 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن عسب الفحل</span> | The prohibition of the testicles of the stallion | C | 54251 |
| 21.62 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن بيع الماء</span> | The prohibition of selling water | C | 54257 |
| 21.63 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من أقال مسلما أقال الله عثرته</span> | Whoever freed a Muslim, Allah freed his sins | C | 54263 |
| 21.64 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا اختلف البيعان وليس بينهما بينة فهو ما يقول رب السلعة أو يتتاركا</span> | If two disputants in a sale have no witness, the sale stands by the words of the seller, or they abandon it | C | 54266 |
| 21.65 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ولد الرجل من كسبه من أطيب كسبه فكلوا من أموالهم</span> | A man’s offspring from his **most noble gain**—eat from their wealth | C | 54268 |
| 21.66 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أد الأمانة إلى من ائتمنك ولا تخن من خانك</span> | Trustworthiness is owed to those you trust and not to those who betray you | C | 54271 |
| 21.67 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يجوز لامرأة أمر في مالها إذا ملك زوجها عصمتها</span> | It is not permissible for a woman to manage her own wealth if her husband has taken her *‘aṣma* (guardianship over her person). | C | 54275 |
| 21.68 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">حفظ الحوائط بالنهار على أهلها وحفظ الماشية بالليل على أهلها وعلى أهل الماشية ما أصابت ماشيتهم</span> | Protecting walls during the day for their owners and protecting livestock at night for their owners and those responsible for the livestock, regarding any damage their animals cause | C | 54280 |
| 21.69 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الآخذ والمعطي سواء في الربا</span> | The **taker (al-ākhud)** and the **giver (al-maʿtū)** are equal in **usury (riba).** | C | 54285 |
| 21.70 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">المسلمون على شروطهم والصلح جائز</span> | The Muslims Are Bound by Their Conditions, and Reconciliation is Permissible | C | 54288 |
| 21.71 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">كل معروف صدقة</span> | Every Good Deed is Charity | C | 54291 |
| 21.72 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">أيما رجل مات أو أفلس فصاحب المتاع أحق بمتاعه إذا وجده بعينه</span> | Which man, if he died or went bankrupt, the owner of the goods is more entitled to his goods if he finds them in his possession | C | 54295 |
| 21.73 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يغلق الرهن له غنمه وعليه غرمه</span> | The pledge (*al-rahn*) is not closed upon the debtor’s sheep while he remains liable for the debt. | C | 54297 |
| 21.74 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إذا كانت الهبة لذي رحم محرم لم يرجع فيها</span> | If the gift is to a relative within prohibited degrees, it cannot be revoked | C | 54307 |
| 21.75 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مكة مناخ لا تباع رباعها ولا تؤاجر بيوتها</span> | Makkah Is a Climate Where Its Four Corners Are Not Sold and Its Houses Are Not Rented | C | 54310 |
| 21.76 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">ذكر تأمين الناس يوم فتح مكة إلا أربعة نفر</span> | Mentioning that only four people were excluded from the security of the day of **Makkah’s surrender** | C | 54314 |
| 21.77 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">حكاية بيع سرق وعتقه ووجه تسميته</span> | The story of a man who bought a slave, freed him, and explained his name’s origin | C | 54316 |
| 21.78 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من فرق بين والدة وولدها فرق الله بينه وبين أحبته يوم القيامة</span> | Whoever separates between a mother and her child, Allah will separate him from his loved ones on the Day of Resurrection | C | 54318 |
| 21.79 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">نهى عن التفريق بين الأم وولدها</span> | He forbade the separation between the mother and her child | C | 54323 |
| 21.80 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">إن الله يحب سمح البيع سمح الشراء سمح القضاء</span> | Indeed, Allah loves leniency in selling, leniency in buying, and leniency in judgment. | C | 54327 |
| 21.81 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن البيع في المسجد ونشدان الضالة فيه</span> | The prohibition of buying and selling in the mosque and calling for lost items therein | C | 54329 |
| 21.82 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن السلف في الحيوان</span> | The prohibition of selling livestock on credit (al-salf fī al-ḥayawān) | C | 54332 |
| 21.83 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن بيع الكالئ بالكالئ</span> | The prohibition of selling the second crop with the second crop | C | 54334 |
| 21.84 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن المحاقلة والمخاضرة والمنابذة</span> | The prohibition of usury (al-muhāḍara), gambling (al-mayṣir), and mutual pledging (al-manābada) | C | 54337 |
| 21.85 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">التشديد في أداء الدين</span> | Strictness in Repaying Debts | C | 54340 |
| 21.86 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الرهن محلوب ومركوب</span> | A pledged animal that is milked and ridden | C | 54342 |
| 21.87 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">الشركة في التجارة</span> | Partnership in trade | C | 54353 |
| 21.88 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">النهي عن بيع فضل الماء</span> | The prohibition of selling the merit of water | C | 54356 |
| 21.89 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">لا يمنع فضل الماء ليمنع به الكلأ</span> | The merit of water should not be prevented by the impurity it may cause. | C | 54359 |
| 21.90 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من بلغه معروف عن أخيه من غير مسألة ولا إشراف نفس فليقبله</span> | Whoever hears a good report about his brother [in faith] without interrogating or scrutinizing, let him accept it | C | 54362 |

| 22.21 | <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">من جهز غازيا في سبيل الله فقد غزا</span> | Whoever prepared for a military campaign in the way of Allah, he has indeed campaigned | C | 54458 |

## Sunan al-Bayhaqi al-Kubra / سنن البيهقي الكبرى

**Schema:** Topical kitāb → bāb → subsidiary heading where present → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Al-Bayhaqī’s large topical Sunan, distinct from al-Nasāʾī’s al-Sunan al-Kubrā.

## Al-Matalib al-'Aliyah / المطالب العالية

**Schema:** Introduction/topical kitāb → bāb → reports.<br><span lang="ar" dir="rtl">مقدمة أو كتاب موضوعي ← باب أو قسم فرعي ← الروايات</span>

Topic-oriented compilation of reports from musnad sources. The source books are musnads, but this work’s TOC is arranged by topics.

**Primary source:** [source table of contents](https://sunna.alifta.gov.sa/BookToc/ViewBookTocLevel?BookId=26&ParentId=0&IsLeaf=False), platform compilation ID 26; original snapshot date 2026-10-07; recovered levels dated in the depth manifest. **Headings by depth:** L1: 44; L2: 1368. **Corpus reports:** 5,603.

### Reproduce the export

```powershell
node scripts/recover-compilation-toc-depth.mjs
node scripts/export-compilation-toc.mjs
```

Recovery reuses validated local snapshots and fetches only missing pages. A local read-only corpus master is required. Detailed source-ID gaps are recorded in `docs/research/hadith/toc-depth-audit.json`.
